scope: Fix the native host cancel/Engine.close test synchronization and add a controlled PID publication regression; no production edits.

originalFailure.testName: explicit host cancel and Engine.close abort and join the same real process while preserving confirmed independent cleanup
originalFailure.qualification: The original full-run failure did not log the captured PID. The source race and deterministic native counterexample establish a mechanism matching the failure; they do not retrospectively prove the exact original captured value.

mechanism: writeFileSync creates/truncates the marker before writing its numeric contents.
The existence-only reader can capture an empty string; Number("") is 0.
process.kill(0, 0) successfully probes the current process group, so the ESRCH assertion fails even after the owned command group has stopped.

counterexample.mutation: Hold native fixture marker empty behind a local publication barrier; engine production and cancel/close assertions unchanged.
counterexample.result: 3/3 original assertions fail with capturedPid=0 while originalGroupProbe=ESRCH. Only a native fixture publication barrier and diagnostics were introduced in an isolated copy.

fix.behavior: Wait for the marker to contain a positive decimal safe integer before capturing the original child PID and invoking cancel/close.
fix.regression: A real host fixture writes an empty marker and waits behind an explicit local publication gate. PID readiness must remain pending before the gate opens; afterward the test observes a positive live PID, cancels the original job and verifies cleanupConfirmed, original group identity, ESRCH, workspace lease availability and no provider calls.
preserved: Original cancel and Engine.close cases and ESRCH assertion
25s test bound, 10s native command budget and existing 10s jobUntil bound
Only signal 0 observations occur in test code; actual termination uses original engine process ownership

negativeControl.mutation: Restore original existence-only PID reader in an isolated emitted test copy; engine production and publication barrier unchanged.
negativeControl.assertion: An empty marker must not publish PID 0

validation.formatAndDiff: Prettier check and git diff --check pass.

limitations: Validation executes a real local POSIX child with engine/SQLite under plain Node on macOS arm64. It does not cover Windows, Linux, Electron GUI or hosted CI.
The parent owns full shared engine build and regression at the next boundary. No shared dist, commits, TODO or goals were changed.

A source-direct tsx attempt produced a separate HOST_COMMAND_EVIDENCE_INVALID closed-transition error. Tests here use consistent isolated emitted source; that attempt is not evidence that the original PID assertion reproduces.
